landmarks.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
landmarks.writeup: A grand royal palace in Seoul, originally built in 1395, symbolizing the Joseon Dynasty's heritage.

landmarks.name: N Seoul Tower
landmarks.writeup: A communication and observation tower offering panoramic views of Seoul.

landmarks.name: Jeju Island
landmarks.writeup: A volcanic island known for its unique natural beauty, including lava tubes and waterfalls.

landmarks.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
landmarks.writeup: A traditional Korean village in Seoul with well-preserved hanok houses.

landmarks.name: DMZ (Demilitarized Zone)
landmarks.writeup: A buffer zone between North and South Korea, symbolizing the ongoing division of the peninsula.

cultural_events.name: Chuseok
cultural_events.writeup: A major harvest festival where families honor ancestors and share traditional food.

cultural_events.name: Seollal
cultural_events.writeup: Korean Lunar New Year celebration involving ancestral rites, games, and traditional food.

cultural_events.name: Boryeong Mud Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual festival featuring mud-based activities promoting health and fun.

cultural_events.name: Jinhae Cherry Blossom Festival
cultural_events.writeup: A spring festival celebrating cherry blossoms with parades and cultural performances.

cultural_events.name: Andong Mask Dance Festival
cultural_events.writeup: A cultural event showcasing traditional mask dances and folk performances.

food_writeup: South Korean cuisine is characterized by bold flavors and diverse dishes such as kimchi, bibimbap, bulgogi, and Korean barbecue, emphasizing fermented foods and a balance of spicy, sour, and savory tastes.
brief_history: South Korea was established in 1948 following the division of Korea after World War II. It experienced rapid economic growth and democratization in the late 20th century, becoming a leading global economy and vibrant democracy.

important_people.name: King Sejong the Great
important_people.description: Creator of the Korean alphabet Hangul

important_people.name: Park Chung-hee
important_people.description: Former President who led economic development

current_conflicts: Tense relations with North Korea persist, including occasional military provocations and unresolved political disputes stemming from the Korean War armistice.
